'''Sephanie Pelden''' is a tirewoman in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]]. Her sister is named [[Naris Pelden|Naris]].

==Appearance==
Sephanie is a shy, stocky woman with a square face.

==Activities==
[[Essande]] hires Sephanie and Naris when [[Elayne Trakand]] comes to [[Caemlyn]], as both are unlikely to be spies{{ref/book|10|12}} She was happy to be a ladies' maid rather than cleaning the halls. She was as much in awe of Essande as she was of Elayne.

All three of the women help both Elayne and [[Aviendha]] bathe and dress.{{ref/book|10|13}}{{ref/book|11|15}}
